annotations.title: Create a tracker issue for a finding

description: Create an issue for a finding in one of the organisation's connected issue trackers (GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Linear or Notion), as the finding page's tracker buttons do. The issue is created in the background with the tracker's configured project and default assignee, and the finding links to it once created. Refused when the finding already has an issue in that tracker or the tracker is not connected and set up. Requires an explicit user request and the Member role or above. Requires write permission.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

provider.description: The connected tracker to create the issue in. NOTION creates a page in the configured database.
